notes: Skill inheritance: a skill is gated only when its inherit code (upstream c[2], else its element) is one of the nine body-type categories (Thrust, Claw, Bite, Weapon, Mouth, Wings, Eye, Talk, Maiden); every other skill is inheritable by any demon, as upstream's recipe generator encodes it. Rank > 89 is never inheritable.

Kinds: an empty special-recipe list marks a demon fusion cannot make — `evolution` when evolutions.json produces it, else `recruit`. A one-pair recipe naming the result itself (e.g. "Matador x Apsaras") is upstream's totem encoding for a Deathstone Fiend and becomes `deathstone[]` with the totem's race.
The cursed chart (cursed-chart.json) ships upstream but upstream's own Nocturne calculator does not wire it; it is imported for reference only and the app labels it so.
`resmods` dropped: five demons carry per-element damage multipliers that no calculation in this app reads.
demon-extras.json key "Laksmi" is mapped to Lakshmi; personality "gantle" is normalised to "gentle"; magatama prereq typo "Droppped" fixed.

Magatama learn levels above 0x3FF are an upstream packed code, not a level (only Marogareh's Pierce: 5268, shown upstream as "5-148"); upstream documents no meaning for it, so it imports as `level: null` — a special unlock.
Upstream `alp` (Strength-based Almighty) imports as `almighty`; the two element-less enemy actions (`-`) import as `special`.
